The present appeal under section 378(1)(3) of the Criminal Procedure Code, 1973 is filed against the judgment and order of acquittal dated 20.09.2008 passed by the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Patan in Criminal Case No.3638 of 1994 whereby the respondent is acquitted of the offences punishable under sections 2(1-a)A and 7(1), 7(5) and 16(1)(a)
(i) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954.

It appears from the communication dated 16.02.2017 addressed by Mr Ravibhai Kantibhai Patel,
son of the respondent-accused, addressed to the Registrar (Judicial) of this Court that Patel Kantibhai Balchandbhai, sole respondent herein herein has expired on 26.10.2012 during the pendency of the present appeal.
The aforesaid communication is accompanied by the death certificate of Patel Kantibhai Balchandbhai, issued by Talati cum Mantri of Kanthravi Gram Panchayat.
